stem.text: The images show an eyepiece graticule and a stage micrometer scale viewed through a microscope.
The smallest divisions of the stage micrometer scale are $0.01\,\text{mm}$.
The images also show a photomicrograph of a transverse section through a plant root using the same eyepiece graticule and the same magnification.

stem.alt: Eyepiece graticule and stage micrometer scale, with a photomicrograph of a plant root transverse section below them; scale markings 0 to 50 and labels X and Y.

stem.text: What is the actual width of the vascular tissue in the plant root between X and Y?
